question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text:
stimulus: do not worry about a few mistakes said the teacher you can learn a lot through your mistakes do we learn from our mistakes asked the boy Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: "Do not worry about a few mistakes," said the teacher. "You can learn a lot through your mistakes." "Do we learn from our mistakes?" asked the boy.
